name: Fraction Disposition Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

BUYU.name: Buy Up
BUYU.definition: Buy securities up to next whole number.

CINL.name: Cash In Lieu Of Fraction
CINL.definition: Fractional part of cash. Take cash in lieu of fractions.

DIST.name: Issue Fraction
DIST.definition: Take distribution of fractions in the form of securities.

RDDN.name: Round Down
RDDN.definition: Round down to the nearest whole number.

RDUP.name: Round Up
RDUP.definition: Round up to the nearest whole number.

STAN.name: Round To Nearest
STAN.definition: If the fraction is greater than or equal to 0.5 of the resulting security then round up, else round down.
